writer: rank_0_only for assembly progress; every rank writes an independent phase-marker file

checkpoint_policy.selection: max(minimum_elements, approximately one percent of the local contiguous partition)

pc_ready_semantics: PC_READY is emitted by rank 0 only after all ranks have confirmed the frozen AIJ/CG/GAMG route. PC_READY_GLOBAL is an explicit companion event.

rank_phase_markers.failure_policy: Marker open/write/flush errors degrade only that rank's telemetry stream and never change the FEM route.

million_element_slices: Checkpoint records emit newly reached one-million-element milestones and seconds_per_million_elements.
global_progress: MPI ranks maintain local insertion counts; a lightweight integer reduction is performed only at local telemetry thresholds; rank 0 writes the resulting global count.
failure_policy: Telemetry write/open errors produce an explicit DEGRADED status and warning; they never fail the FEM calculation.
